description: Bit-identical check for the 2026-07-07 warmup_prefetch parameter (BacktestEngine.warmup_cutoff_timestamp, launcher.run_backtest's warmup_prefetch). Captured by running the identical backtest against the pre-change code (git stash of backtester.py/launcher.py/trading_bot.py) and the post-change code with warmup_prefetch omitted (defaults False) -- the two metrics.json outputs matched byte-for-byte as dicts.
note: warmup_prefetch defaults to False and must never change engine.load_data's fetch range or introduce a warmup_cutoff_timestamp when omitted. Fails if: the default value of warmup_prefetch changes, load_data's default start_date handling changes, or _process_symbol_candle_completion's cutoff check fires when it shouldn't.
e010_s3_rebaseline_2026-09-10: DECLARED DEFAULT-BEHAVIOR CHANGE (CLAUDE.fork.md rule #4), not a regression -- see tests/fixtures/reference_run.json's own e010_s3_rebaseline_2026-09-10 note. Real per-symbol slippage (BTCUSDT=1bps) became the default; net_pnl/sharpe move -- 1.904077/15.665 -> 1.504327/13.747 -- from the fill-price adjustment on this window's 2 trades. trade_count is UNCHANGED at 2. Measured by re-running this exact fixture's backtest against the post-S3 code on 2026-09-10. Shared by tests/test_commission_rate_param.py and tests/test_warmup_prefetch_bit_identical.py.
cul356_rebaseline_2026-10-01: DECLARED DEFAULT-BEHAVIOR CHANGE (CUL-356), not a regression. This fixture's strategy is FearGreedContrarianComponent; fear & greed is now usable one day after its date (FEED_DELAY_SECONDS, A8.4), so the backtest engine no longer gives the 00:00 bar of day D day D's value. On the old window (2024-01-01..2024-01-11) that leaves 1 trade (net_pnl -3.79206, sharpe 0.0), and tests/test_commission_rate_param.py needs a second trade, so the window is extended to 2024-01-16: 2 trades, net_pnl 1.504327 -> -2.581979, sharpe 13.747 -> -6.285 (was 2024-01-11). Measured twice on the post-CUL-356 code on 2026-10-01, identical.
